description: A tuple of numbers selected beside a list of strings becomes a list of strings
notes: The spec says list and tuple types unify by preferring the tuple type, so the selected tuple would stay a tuple holding the number 1. hashicorp/hcl unifies the tuple's element types as a list, a list of numbers, unifies that with the list of strings to a list of strings, and converts the tuple to it (unifyTuplesAsList in cty/convert/unify.go), so the result is a list holding the string "1".
